title: /model size warning gives three different conversation sizes, and says ~46.1k is 'over' a 49.2k window
observed: kiln defect (wording/accuracy). Just before the switch, /context said 'anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 · 96k of 1000k tokens' (conversation 78.8k). '/model ollama/qwen3.8:latest' then printed: 'Now on ollama/qwen3.8:latest · medium tier · 37.5k usable. The conversation (~46.1k tokens) is over qwen3.8:latest's 49.2k window: the next message compacts it with qwen3.8:latest first, in parts that fit. Or /compact now to summarise it with anthropic/claude-opus-4-8, which holds all of it' (no final period). The footer then showed 'ctx ━━━━━━━━━━ 196%'. Compaction actually read 19.1k + 1.2k prompt tokens. 46.1k < 49.2k, so the sentence contradicts itself (the real limit is the 37.5k usable).
expected: One consistent number (or say which tokenizer each estimate uses), compared against the limit that matters ('~46k, more than the 37.5k usable in qwen3.8's 49.2k window'). The footer percentage should agree with it.
